title: Docflow: sample app checklist & tutorial fixes — morning log
content:
Morning scratchpad — docflow + sample apps
Owner: Mika Tanaka (quick personal log)
Date: 2026-03-13 morning edits

High-level goal:
- Get two small sample apps and one quickstart tutorial to a minimal shipping state so community contributors can follow them without hand-holding. Focus: accuracy of steps, up-to-date API calls, and consistent screenshots.

Top priorities for today (order matters):
1) Threaded chat sample: fix race in message ordering + update README steps
   - Symptom: replies sometimes render before parent messages when streaming is enabled (noticed on firefox).
   - Repro: run local sample, open two browser tabs, send reply quickly after parent; observe ordering flip ~60% of time.
   - Likely cause: client-side naive prepend/append when streaming events arrive out-of-order. Need sequence ids from server or buffer reorder.
   - Quick patch: add simple sequence buffer in client (branch: mika/threaded-chat-fix).
   - Tests to run: manual multi-tab + unit for ordering algorithm.
   - PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/pull/88 (draft)
   - TODO: add short note in README about streaming caveat and link to console setting for 'streaming-mode'.

2) Embeddings quickstart tutorial (docs site)
   - Problem: code sample uses old SDK call `create_embedding` (deprecated); needs `embeddings.create` and new param names.
   - Action: update code block, run snippet locally to verify output JSON shape.
   - Also capture console screenshot for 'Create key' flow (console v2) — screenshot coords: left nav + API keys panel.
   - Linked issue: LIN-3421 (embedding tutorial mismatch)
   - Scratch steps:
      * checkout docs repo 
      * run `python quickstart_embeddings.py` with test toy dataset (see samples/embeddings/test-data.json)
      * confirm shape: {"data": [...], "model": "rwd-embedding-1"}
   - TODO: add note about cost estimate for 1k items.

3) Quickstart: Console-based rollout screenshot sweep
   - Need 3 screenshots: rollout list, canary rollout modal, rollback button confirmation.
   - Screenflow: Console > Deployments > Rollouts > open canary > screenshot.
   - UX ask: check with Product (Asha) whether copy for the canary modal changed last week. If yes, update copy in docs.

Doc gaps I keep bumping into (need to create tickets):
- No clear doc that maps SDK config options to Console toggles (batch-size, kv-cache, quantized-variant). Users get confused which setting lives where. -> create doc mapping page + short table.
- Example showing recommended batching config for low-latency chat vs high-throughput emb pipeline is missing. Add two small YAML snippets.
- No canonical sample for private deployment auth flow (VPC + KMS example). Need at least one minimal example in samples/private-deploy.

Quick wins (30–60m tasks):
- Add README note to threaded-chat sample about streaming caveat (15m).
- Update embeddings quickstart code block to new SDK signature and run snippet (40m).
- Draft Linear tickets for 'SDK <-> Console mapping' and 'private deploy auth sample' (20m each).

Meeting notes / context to remember:
- Product sync 2026-03-12: Asha wants rollout screenshots before EOD Friday for the marketing snapshot.
- Engineering: Benji said he'll accept small client-only buffering patch; recommended server change if problem persists.

Notes to self / style reminders for docs:
- Keep code samples < 30 lines where possible. If longer, link to a gist or sample repo.
- Always show minimal curl + SDK example for same action (create embedding, start session, create rollout).
- Prefer active voice and second-person (you) for quickstarts.
- Add 'cost note' callouts for embedding-heavy samples.

Open questions / follow-ups:
- Product: confirm canary modal copy. Tag: @asha in slack #prod-docs.
- SRE: is there a new recommended header for private deployments when using customer KMS? (cc: Remy).
- DevX: should we move sample repos under a mono-repo for easier sync between docs and samples? Pros/cons list needed.

Next actions (today):
- 09:30 - implement minimal client buffer in threaded-chat branch + quick manual test.
- 11:00 - update embeddings quickstart code + run local snippet.
- 14:00 - create Linear tickets, file screenshots task, ping Asha.
- 16:00 - open PR for README note and link PRs in the docs patch.

End-of-day wrapup (to fill later):
- what merged, what blocked, quick wins shipping tomorrow.

Scratch dump (things to remember later):
- sample: add 'dev' Dockerfile that pins exact runtime deps.
- consider adding a small harness to run all quickstart snippets in CI nightly (fail only on syntax/runtime errors).
- reminder: test samples on both linux and mac (M1) where quantization path differs.

Random TODOs (not urgent):
- add CONTRIBUTING.md to samples with basic PR checklist.
- consolidate screenshots folder naming (rollouts_v2, rollouts_v1).

-- Mika
